name: Dhananjay Bendre
headline: Leading Consulting Business at Oracle India with strong Leadership skills.
position: Senior Director - Consulting ( India & Srilanka Business Head )
about:
India Consulting Business Head | Cloud Transformation | Large Multi-Country Deals | Oracle Product Expert | Leadership | Innovation | Team Building | Global Experience

With 35+ years of extensive experience in IT, business management, private equity, and consulting, I am passionate about driving innovative, large-scale business transformations that enable customers to unlock the full potential of technology.

In my current role as India Consulting Business Head at Oracle, my key focus is on leading Cloud Transformation deals, managing large multi-country programs, and collaborating across all pillars of Oracle—Tech, Apps, SaaS, and PaaS—to deliver comprehensive solutions that drive business impact.

I am recognized for my strong leadership skills, ability to foster high-performing teams, and drive innovative approaches that solve complex challenges. With significant experience in team building, I empower diverse teams to achieve ambitious goals while maintaining a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.

Having worked in multiple geographies including the US, Gulf Region, and APAC, I bring a global perspective to business strategy and execution. I have successfully led large transformation projects across industries, helping enterprises modernize operations and embrace digital innovation at scale.

Based in Mumbai, I enjoy traveling and exploring new cultures, which complements my global outlook and ability to connect across markets and business contexts.

 Also Certified Independent Director.
